---
title: Cheddar Chive Drop Biscuits
category: baking
contributor: Mom
prepTime: 15 min
cookTime: 18 min
servings: "10"
tags: [biscuits, weeknight, sample]
notes: Sample starter recipe. Serve with stew or scrambled eggs. Don't overmix.
---

## Ingredients

- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1 tsp kosher salt
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar
- 1/4 cup chopped chives
- 3/4 cup cold buttermilk, plus more as needed

## Steps

1. Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a sheet with parchment.
2. Whisk flour, baking powder, salt, and garlic powder. Cut in butter until pea-sized.
3. Toss in cheddar and chives. Stir in buttermilk until the dough is shaggy and just holds together.
4. Drop 10 mounds onto the sheet. Bake 16 to 18 minutes until browned on the bottoms.
